name: Broulim's Fresh Foods (Montpelier, ID) Hot Deli Rotisserie Chicken, Mashed Potatoes & Rolls
brandOrRestaurant: Broulim's Fresh Foods Deli & Bakery (Montpelier, ID)
whyItWorks: The #1 flare-safe rescue on the Idaho side of Bear Lake: hot roasted chicken breast and scratch-baked soft white dinner rolls from the Montpelier Broulim's deli.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick up a hot rotisserie chicken (eat the skinless breast meat), a bag of famous Broulim's soft white bakery rolls, and bananas/broth for the cabin.
watchOuts: Remove seasoned chicken skin if flaring
Skip fried potato wedges ("JoJos") in favor of mashed potatoes or rolls
